newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-THREE ALBION PLAYERS SENT OFF AS THEY CRASH TO DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THREE ALBION PLAYERS SENT OFF AS THEY CRASH TO DEFEAT.

text.p: Albion Rovers had three men sent off as they tumbled 4-0 away to fellow third division side Forfar in a Scottish Cup first round replay on Monday.

Paul Martin, David Burn and Colin McFarlane were red-carded for second bookable offences to make it a night of misery for Albion. The visitors also had three men booked, Martin Clark, Ian Harty and Tommy Walker.
John Allison fired Forfar's opener just before the break. Ben Honeyman in 75 minutes, Iain Lee four minutes later and Alan Morgan just before the final whistle added the others.
